title: Freelance Service Contract
shortDesc: For freelance developers, designers, writers, and consultants
shortDesc_hi: डेवलपर, डिजाइनर, लेखक और स्वतंत्र सलाहकारों के लिए

questions.label: Client Name or Company
questions.hint: Name of the entity paying for your work
questions.hint_hi: काम का भुगतान करने वाले का नाम

questions.label: Freelancer Full Name
questions.hint: Your full legal name as per PAN/bank account
questions.hint_hi: बैंक खाते के अनुसार आपका पूरा नाम

questions.label: Deliverables & Scope of Work
questions.placeholder: e.g. Complete UI/UX design of 10 mobile app screens in Figma with prototype
questions.placeholder_hi: उदा. फिगमा में 10 स्क्रीन का मोबाइल ऐप यूआई डिजाइन एवं प्रोटोटाइप
questions.hint: Be specific to avoid unpaid scope creep
questions.hint_hi: काम का दायरा बिल्कुल स्पष्ट लिखें ताकि अतिरिक्त काम न करना पड़े

questions.label: Total Agreed Fee (in ₹)
questions.hint: Total payment for the complete scope of work
questions.hint_hi: पूरे काम का कुल तय शुल्क

questions.label: Payment Milestone Schedule
questions.placeholder: 50% advance before start, 50% upon final delivery
questions.placeholder_hi: 50% काम शुरू होने से पहले, 50% अंतिम डिलीवरी पर
questions.hint: Always demand an upfront advance before beginning work
questions.hint_hi: काम शुरू करने से पहले एडवांस भुगतान की शर्त जरूर रखें

questions.label: Target Delivery Date
questions.label_hi: काम पूरा होने की अंतिम तारीख
questions.hint: Deadline for handover of final deliverables
questions.hint_hi: तैयार काम सौंपने की अंतिम तिथि

questions.label: Included Revisions Count
questions.hint: Number of revision cycles included before extra charges apply
questions.hint_hi: अतिरिक्त शुल्क लागू होने से पहले कितने संशोधन शामिल हैं

clauses.title: Engagement & Services
clauses.legal: THIS INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR AGREEMENT confirms the engagement between {clientName} (hereinafter 'Client') and {freelancerName} (hereinafter 'Contractor') for provision of services encompassing: {serviceScope}.
clauses.note: Ensure scope exclusions (what you will NOT do) are clear.
clauses.note_hi: यह भी स्पष्ट रखें कि कौन सा काम इस फीस में शामिल नहीं है।

clauses.title: Compensation & Milestones
clauses.plain: The Client agrees to pay ₹{totalFee} according to the schedule: {paymentTerms}. Work starts only after receiving the agreed advance.
clauses.legal: In consideration of satisfactory completion, the Client covenants to pay total compensation of INR {totalFee}/- payable pursuant to: {paymentTerms}. Work commencement is contingent upon receipt of the initial advance.
clauses.note: Never transfer editable source files before the final invoice is paid in full.
clauses.note_hi: पूरा भुगतान मिलने से पहले कभी भी मुख्य सोर्स फाइल न दें।

clauses.title: Delivery & Revisions
clauses.plain: The Freelancer will deliver the work by {deliveryDate}. This fee includes up to {revisionLimit} rounds of reasonable revisions. Any additional changes will be billed separately.
clauses.legal: The Contractor shall complete milestones on or before {deliveryDate}. The agreed consideration encompasses up to {revisionLimit} cycles of minor modifications. Out-of-scope revisions shall be billed at mutually agreed supplementary rates.
clauses.note: Revisions must align with original scope, not create a new project.
clauses.note_hi: रिवीजन मूल काम के दायरे में ही होना चाहिए, नया काम नहीं।

clauses.title: Ownership of Work (IP Rights)
clauses.plain: All copyright and ownership of the completed work will transfer to the Client ONLY AFTER full payment of ₹{totalFee} is received by the Freelancer.
clauses.legal: All intellectual property rights and copyrights in the deliverables shall assign to the Client SOLELY UPON receipt of full and final settlement of INR {totalFee}/- by the Contractor.
clauses.note: Crucial clause: if client defaults on payment, they cannot legally use your work.
clauses.note_hi: जरूरी नियम: यदि क्लाइंट भुगतान नहीं करता, तो वह आपके काम का उपयोग नहीं कर सकता।

clauses.title: Independent Contractor Status
clauses.plain: The Freelancer is an independent contractor and not an employee of the Client. The Freelancer manages their own taxes and schedule.
clauses.legal: The Contractor's relationship with the Client is solely that of an independent contractor. Nothing herein shall create any employer-employee, agency, or partnership relationship under Indian labor laws.
clauses.note: Protects both parties regarding provident fund and employee benefit claims.
clauses.note_hi: यह दोनों पक्षों को कर्मचारी भविष्य निधि आदि दावों से स्पष्ट रखता है।

warnings.title: No Advance Payment Specified
warnings.message: Starting freelance work without a minimum 30% to 50% upfront advance is high risk. In case of client ghosting or cancellation, recovery without an advance is difficult.
warnings.message_hi: बिना 30-50% एडवांस लिए काम शुरू करना जोखिम भरा है। भुगतान न मिलने पर नुकसान हो सकता है।
warnings.action: Update payment terms to require an advance deposit before work begins.
warnings.action_hi: शर्तों में काम शुरू करने से पहले एडवांस की शर्त जोड़ें।
